# Review finding: retry or resilience path silently swapped while making an unrelated change (Python, P1)

Pattern: a change described as input normalization (trimming a preference ID) also replaced `repository.read_resilient(key)` with `repository.read_once(key.strip())`. That dropped the bounded 3-attempt retry on TransientRead. The test was then rewritten to assert the regression: TransientRead is raised and the backend is called once.

What to check: when a diff changes a call target (resilient → once, safe → raw, cached → uncached) as well as the stated change, confirm the contract is kept. Look out for tests that were renamed or rewritten to assert the new behavior instead of the documented contract.

Fix: apply the normalization inside the existing resilient call, e.g. `read_resilient(key.strip())`. Keep tests that check the retry happens and that permanent errors are not retried.
